items.title: M&T aims to ‘dial up’ credit card rewards
items.why: Simple rewards are gaining ground among regional issuers; watch whether M&T sets a new benchmark for mass-affluent cards.
items.summary_ai: Regional lender M&T plans simpler, easier-to-understand credit card rewards based on customer feedback.
items.take: Simple rewards are gaining ground among regional issuers; watch whether M&T sets a new benchmark for mass-affluent cards.
